headline: Google's new Gemma 4 12B model is designed to run on any laptop with 16GB of RAM, while regulators are requiring Google to offer a tool allowing website publishers to opt-out of generative AI search features
tldr: Today in AI, Google unveiled its new Gemma 4 12B model, while regulators are taking steps to give publishers more control over AI search features. Additionally, Meta's AI agent for WhatsApp Business is now available globally, and Coralogix has raised $200M to build a monitoring layer for AI agents. Researchers are also making advancements in areas such as physical AI, autonomous driving, and agent training at scale.
